newsitem.title: USA: Marathon lowers U.S. posted crude 50 cts/bbl. [CORRECTED 22:48 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Marathon lowers U.S. posted crude 50 cts/bbl. [CORRECTED 22:48 GMT]

text.p: Marathon Oil, a unit of USX Corp, said it had lowered the price it will pay for most U.S. crude oil by 50 cents per barrel, effective Monday.
The decrease brings the new price for U.S. benchmark grade West Texas Intermediate to $19.00 (corrects from $19.50) a barrel and West Texas Sour to $17.50 (corrects from $17.90) a barrel.
Light Louisiana sweet crude is now $19.25 and Oklahoma sweet is $19.00 (corrects from $19.50).
